Warning Signs

Your Car Is Telling You Something

These are the signs that your car needs professional attention — and the longer you wait, the harder they are to fix.

Swirl Marks & Scratches

Those spiderweb scratches you see in sunlight are from improper washing. They get deeper over time and lower your car's resale value.

Faded or Oxidised Paint

Chalky, dull paint means UV damage has set in. Left untreated it etches through the clear coat and can require an expensive respray.

Persistent Interior Odours

Smells from food, smoke, or mildew trapped in fabric and vents don't just go away. Steam treatment is the only way to eliminate them fully.

Water Spots on Glass or Paint

Hard water minerals etch into clear coat and glass if left. Early treatment takes minutes. Ignoring them can mean glass replacement.

Brown Stained Wheels

That rust-coloured residue on your rims is brake dust bonding to the alloy. It corrodes the metal underneath if not removed regularly.

Sticky or Cracked Leather

Dried-out leather cracks and peels permanently. Regular conditioning keeps it supple — but once the cracking starts, there's no reversing it.
